shelf_life.t: 12 months from date of production if stored in unopened, undamaged and original sealed packaging.

overcoat_wait.t: Can be overcoated with water/solvent based polymer paints - contact the paint manufacturer for details. When overcoating with Sikagard or SikaColor Emulsion or solvent based coating, wait at least 5 hours after the hydrophobic impregnation.
